summary: Require patched Go certificate verification for supported builds
details: Update minimum Go to 1.26.10 and current Go to 1.27.3 for GO-2026-6809, reached through the Sigstore certificate verifier.
Pin matching compiler images and refresh current build selections and native-source reviews; retain earlier toolchains and dated evidence as historical observations.

compatibility.notes: The minimum build compiler is now Go 1.26.10 and the preferred compiler is Go 1.27.3. Upstream certificate verification intentionally rejects the compromised intermediates covered by the advisory; no HTTP schema or database migration changes.

security: GO-2026-6809 adds an upstream denylist for known untrustworthy intermediate certificates. This does not establish vulnerability absence or replace operator trust-store updates.
limitations: Existing published releases and images are historical and are not rebuilt or changed in place by this source update.
New hosted builds, independent review and publication remain separate actions; prior qualification records describe their recorded compiler versions.
